detection_rule_note: Weight detection = S1's own rule (gaussian_ratio >= module_gaussian_ratio_p99, the weight_module_p99_top comparison). 1-D detection = rise of outliers_above_group_p99_9 over the clean baseline of the same tensor; S1's role-outlier listing condition recorded separately. Embedding detection measured through S1's analyze_embedding_tensor. Conv per-channel z is auxiliary: S1 loads conv4d_channel_norm_z_p99 but never applies it to outlier decisions.

1.15x_median.note: outlier_rows_above_p99 is invariant to single-row replacements because S1 recomputes p99 from the perturbed distribution itself (measured: 494 -> 494 at every multiplier); the absolute row-norm comparisons are the effective detection lines.

summary.verdict_statement: Measured against the real S1 screen: S1's module-p99 rule has 0/48 (0.0%) sensitivity to rank-1 additions at 0.1%-3.0% Frobenius norm, first detects at 20.0%, and does not reach 12/12 within the tested ladder (max 10/12 at 100.0% because two transformer out_proj tensors stay below their module p99 even at a 100%-norm injection). Single-channel 4-D Conv additions: the spectral rule first detects at > 100.0%; the auxiliary channel-z measure first fires at 20.0% (not part of S1's outlier decision). 1-D bias single-element additions first raise group-p99.9 outliers at 10sigma. Language token-embedding row replacements first exceed the row-norm p99 at 1.15x_median, the lexical max at 1.50x_median, and the clean NN-cosine max at cos_0.80.
